searchText: We just store the justification information for each block in the database so we can reload it without recreating the whole state. And they’re small and only stored for non finalised blocks so it’s not a concern for storage size. When you say that they are only stored for non finalized blocks, you actively remove this from dbase when the blocks are finalized? Yep as part of the pruning process when finalising. thanks, this does work, and we need to fix our pruning of non-canonical nodes anyway 😄 We moved to this model as part of the follow up to the medalla chaos. We used to wind up replaying non finalised blocks and it didn’t go well for medalla. I started lurking just when Medalla blew out, but I remember Victor at Prysmatic going crazy with the init-sync code at the time refactoring this, I suspect it was the same cause RAM was exploding so probably they were loading everything to forkchoice. I know very little about database handling so not sure how painful it would be adding the justified info, I suppose it should be fine
